messages:
lucy_docs: Quick ping 1 opened a docs PR adding a tiny console observability recipe: 'dashboard for per-route cost + median latency' and inline SDK snippets. Preview job errored with a 400 from the trace ingest. anyone seen this pattern?

ben_m: link?

lucy_docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4891 1: playground render shows `400 Bad Request` from /ingest/traces. snippet env uses `TRACE_TOKEN`. our SDK uses `TRACE_KEY` in examples.

infra_tom: yep thats the mismatch. Also the sample dashboard YAML references `metric.billing_usd` which we replaced with `cost_cents` last quarter. small rename needed.

lucy_docs: argh, copy-paste fail. i'll change the env var and YAML. can someone suggest a 1-line snippet for extracting `route` from trace metadata in Ruby? we don't have ruby in this doc.

ben_m: tiny ruby example:```ruby
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::TraceHook.new(ENV['TRACE_KEY'])
trace = client.latest
puts "route=#{trace.metadata['route']} latency_ms=#{trace.latency_ms} cost_cents=#{trace.metrics['cost']}"
```

lucy_docs: perfect 1 i'll add that. also going to include a note that UIs should divide `cost_cents` by 100 to show dollars.

preview-bot: Preview deployed: https://playground.redwood.test/pr-4891-preview (expires in 24h)

infra_tom: when you push the fix, consider adding a tiny `docs:snippets-smoke` CI job that renders snippets and POSTS a small test trace to the sandbox. catches env var/name drift early.

lucy_docs: good idea. adding a very small smoke step in the PR. i'll re-run once CI completes and merge if green. thanks!
